en: Dependent on a mundane wholesome state, a supramundane or unwholesome state does not arise by way of root condition. ... Under root condition there are two; ... up to ... under non-disappearance condition there are two.

Dependent on a mundane unwholesome state, a supramundane or non-unwholesome state does not arise by way of root condition. Under root condition there is one; ... up to ... under non-disappearance condition there is one.

Dependent on a mundane indeterminate state, a mundane or non-indeterminate state does not arise by way of root condition. ... Under root condition there are two; ... up to ... under non-disappearance condition there are two.
